data: For fiscal 2025, Apple spent more on research and development than Microsoft. Apple's R&D expense was $34,550 million (about $34.6 billion) for the year ended September 27, 2025, versus $32,488 million (about $32.5 billion) for Microsoft's fiscal year ended June 30, 2025. Apple's figure is roughly 1.06 times Microsoft's, a gap of about $2.1 billion or 6.3%. Note that the two companies' fiscal years end at different times, and relative to revenue Microsoft invested more, at about 11.5% of its $281.7 billion in revenue compared with about 8.3% of Apple's $416.2 billion in net sales.
